content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rewari Faculty (Group-A) Vacancy Details (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 15 posts are available across various departments for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor positions.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rewari Faculty (Group-A) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens or persons registered as Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Note: The essential qualification for the post of Associate Professor remains the same as for the Assistant Professor of the respective discipline, along with required additional teaching/research experience.

rows.qualification_required: 1. A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II or part II of the third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956.2. MD in Anesthesiology or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto.3. Three years teaching and/or research experience in a recognized Institution in the subject of specialty after obtaining the qualifying degree.

For Medical Candidates: 1. Medical qualification under IMC Act 1956. 2. M.D./M.S. in Anatomy or equivalent. 3. Three years teaching/research experience after qualifying degree. For Non-Medical Candidates: 1. Master's Degree in Anatomy. 2. Doctorate degree from a recognized University. 3. Three years teaching/research experience after Doctorate degree.

For Medical Candidates: 1. Medical qualification under IMC Act 1956. 2. MD in Biochemistry or equivalent. 3. Three years teaching/research experience after qualifying degree. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rewari Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 50 (Fifty) years for all posts. The cut-off date for determining eligibility in terms of age is the last date of submission of applications (7 November 2026). Note: The upper age limit, even after availing age relaxation, shall not exceed 55 years on the cut-off date.

content_sections.text: Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited for all posts. The period of probation for all faculty posts is two years. If applying for more than one post, candidates must submit separate application forms and fees for each post. faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Rewari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Rewari Recruitment 2026 is an offline direct recruitment drive for Faculty (Group-A) posts including Associate Professor and Assistant Professor across various medical departments under notification FAC./02/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Rewari Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies (including 1 PwBD backlog post) have been advertised for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rewari Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy of the application form by hand or by post is 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AIIMS Rewari recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 3,000/- for UR/OBC/EWS candidates, Rs. 2,400/- for SC/ST candidates (refundable if appearing in the interview), and PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Rewari Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 50 years for all posts, with applicable age relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.
